author: Trash0303
quote: At this point, I genuinely think the only people enjoying this game are people who get excited about doing household chores because their wife's boyfriend told them to. Either that or people who are perfectly content being cucked by a game they've waited 13 years to play. This game is terrible. The story is awful, the missions are extremely boring, and the gameplay gets repetitive incredibly fast. The attention to detail is impressive, but none of that matters when the actual experience is SO dull. You're essentially spending your time completing glorified errands and pretending there's something entertaining about it trying to chalk it up to "realism". The only enjoyable part is running around k*lling random people, and that gets boring very fast. I've never experienced such a massive disconnect between the hype surrounding a game and how disappointing it actually is. Thirteen years of anticipation for something this underwhelming is almost impressive in its own right. Rockstar had over a decade to deliver something memorable, and somehow managed to make a game that feels more like a second job than entertainment. This isn't a disappointing GTA. It's a colossal waste of potential.
